requirements.title: Project State
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: FR-001 must be realized by implementing FR-007 and FR-008 as atomic components.
requirements.description: Provides global project state, including requirements, stakeholders, business rules, expert rules, and other metadata. This requirement is composite and should be decomposed into atomic requirements FR-007 (Atomic Requirements) and FR-008 (Project State Components).

requirements.title: Requirements Management
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Requirements must be creatable, readable, updatable, deletable, and searchable via the provided tools.
requirements.description: Central hub for defining, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching requirements.

requirements.title: Business Rules
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Business rules must be configurable, applied, and enforceable via the business rule tools.
requirements.description: Implements business rules logic, allowing enforcement of rules across the system.

requirements.title: Expert Rules
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Expert rules must be creatable, editable, and searchable via the expert rule tools.
requirements.description: Handles expert rules, enabling reasoning and meta‑level checks within the system.

requirements.title: Ambiguity Detection
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Text must be analyzed for ambiguity and flagged according to D26 rule.
requirements.description: Detects ambiguous phrasing in textual requirements, applying D26 rule to reduce misunderstandings.

requirements.title: Impact Analysis
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Impact analysis must reveal dependent requirements, code intersections, and risk level for modifications.
requirements.description: Analyzes impact of changes across the codebase, identifying affected requirements, code sections, and test coverage.

requirements.title: Atomic Requirements
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Each requirement must be atomic and indivisible; no composite sub‑requirements allowed.

requirements.title: Project State Components
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Project State Components: store and retrieve global project state (requirements, stakeholders, business rules, expert rules, etc.) via core store, exposing resource 'project-state'.

expertRules.name: Проверка атомарности требований
expertRules.description: Требование должно быть атомарным (описывать одну функциональность)
expertRules.example: Система должна позволять создавать и редактировать требования

expertRules.name: Проверка неоднозначных терминов
expertRules.description: Проверка на наличие субъективных и неизмеримых терминов
expertRules.example: Система должна работать быстро и удобно

expertRules.name: Обязательность критериев приемки
expertRules.description: Требование должно содержать детализированные критерии приемки

expertRules.name: Requirement Completeness
expertRules.description: Ensure each requirement is not composed of multiple sub‑requirements; each requirement must be atomic and indivisible.
expertRules.checkLogic: function NO_SUB_REQUIREMENTS(requirement) { const title = requirement.title || ''; const description = requirement.description || ''; const conjunctions = [' и ', ', а также ', ', также ', ', кроме ', ', плюс ']; const issues = []; if (conjunctions.some(c => title.includes(c) || description.includes(c))) { issues.push('Требование может быть составным. Разделите на несколько атомарных требований.'); } if (description.split('.').filter(Boolean).length > 3) { issues.push('Описание слишком длинное и может содержать несколько функциональностей.'); } return { pass: issues.length === 0, message: issues.length === 0 ? 'Требование атомарно' : 'Нарушение атомарности, ' + issues.join(',')}; }
